FX-CRANGE-001.says: The settings as they start: Lab, every end of the box 0, fuzziness 0. No colour has a* or b* as low as -128, so nothing is keyed and the layer is as it was.

FX-CRANGE-002.says: Lab, a box about the green screen (L 120 to 200, a 40 to 100, b 150 to 220), fuzziness 0: the green screen's top four rows and pure green's middle rows, inside the same box, lose all their covering; everything else keeps all of it.

FX-CRANGE-003.says: The same box with fuzziness 30: the screen still all gone; colours just outside the box keep a share of their covering, d / 30.

FX-CRANGE-004.says: YUV, a box about the blue screen (Y 20 to 120, U 170 to 230, V 80 to 125), fuzziness 20: the blue screen falls, the half-covered one too; pure blue (U about 255) keeps all its covering and its darker rows fall; the violet keeps a share.

FX-CRANGE-005.says: RGB, a box about green (R 0 to 90, G 140 to 255, B 0 to 110), fuzziness 40: pure green and the green screen fall, cyan and yellow, far outside in blue or red, keep all their covering.

FX-CRANGE-006.says: RGB, the whole cube (every min 0, every max 255), fuzziness 1: every pixel is inside, so the whole layer is keyed out.

FX-CRANGE-007.says: Lab with the whole range of L and b but a* only from -8 to 40 (a 120 to 168), fuzziness 2: the greys, black and white (a* 0), skin, the blue screen and the pale blue fall; the greens (a* below -8) and pure red, magenta and pure blue (above 40) keep their covering.

FX-CRANGE-008.says: RGB, a minimum above its maximum (red from 200 down to 100): no colour is inside, and with fuzziness 60 a pixel keeps the share of its distance past the nearer end, so mid reds lose some covering.

FX-CRANGE-009.says: Fuzziness 255 about the green screen in Lab: the softest edge; colours near green lose much of their covering, the far ones little.

FX-CRANGE-010.says: Fuzziness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 80 at frame 4, linear, about the green screen in Lab.

FX-CRANGE-011.says: RGB, the top of green keyed from 255 at frame 0 to 150 at frame 4, the rest of FX-CRANGE-005: the box shrinks and fewer greens fall.

FX-CRANGE-012.says: FX-CRANGE-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-CRANGE-013.says: Fuzziness 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CRANGE-014.says: Fuzziness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CRANGE-015.says: Min (L, Y, R) 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CRANGE-016.says: Max (b, V, B) -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CRANGE-017.says: Colour space "Lab": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CRANGE-018.says: Colour space "hsl": not one of Lab, YUV and RGB. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
